title: Thermomix Pumpkin Soup
description: Smooth, gently spiced butternut soup. A potato gives it body without much cream. Freezes well.

confidence.note: Built from technique. Not yet cooked; the amounts follow common Thermomix pumpkin soup proportions.

items.item: toasted pepitas, a swirl of cream and crusty bread

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Add the onion ({{onion}}) and garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) to the bowl. Chop 3 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Add the olive oil ({{oil}}). Sauté 3 min / 120°C / Speed 1.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add the pumpkin ({{pumpkin}}), potato ({{potato}}), stock ({{stock}}), cumin ({{cumin}}), nutmeg ({{nutmeg}}), salt ({{salt}}) and pepper ({{pepper}}). Cook 20 min / 100°C / Speed 1, until the pumpkin is soft enough to crush with the spatula.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: With the MC in place, blend 1 min / Speed 5–10, increasing the speed gradually so the hot soup does not surge.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add the cream ({{cream}}), if using, and mix 10 sec / Speed 3. Taste for salt and pepper. Serve with pepitas and crusty bread.

notes.title: Capacity
notes.text: These amounts land around 1.7L. Do not scale past 4 serves in one batch; blending hot soup near the top of the bowl is where spills happen.

notes.title: Roasted version
notes.text: For a deeper flavour, air fry the pumpkin pieces in 1 tsp oil at 200°C for 15 minutes first, then cut the cook in step 3 to 12 minutes.

notes.title: Thickness
notes.text: Too thick: add hot water 50g at a time and mix 10 sec / Speed 3. Too thin: cook 5 min / 100°C / Speed 1 with the MC off.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: 4 days in the fridge, 3 months in the freezer. Add the cream after reheating rather than before freezing.
